Natural Blue Stone
Rough Cut Mineral Bookends
Vintage, Polished Flat Face
This pair of bookends is crafted from natural blue mineral stone, showcasing a striking contrast between the raw, crystalline textures of the exterior and the smooth, polished surface designed to sit flush against books. The pale blue and white coloration offers a serene, organic aesthetic that bridges natural history with functional interior decor, making these pieces suitable for modern, bohemian, or eclectic library settings.
Set of two rough-hewn stone bookends with one polished vertical face each
Natural mineral formations featuring varying shades of light blue, aqua, and white
Substantial weight provides stable support for standard book collections
Padded felt bases to protect furniture surfaces from scratches
Measures approximately 4.5" in height; combined weight of 3.4 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The stone retains its natural jagged texture on three sides with no evidence of non-natural fractures or repairs. The polished faces are smooth and flat with only minor surface-level artifacts inherent to natural mineral specimens. Felt pads are intact on both bases.
